name: @hoardodile/desktop
description: Windows Electron shell around the hoardodile Fastify sidecar.
author: wooloo26

scripts.package: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-resources.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:publish: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-resources.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win --x64 --publish always
